transcript.text: "Can I tell you something? I stole medicine from the stash once and never confessed."
"Knew it. You've got good instincts for this stuff."
"Huh. I wouldn't have guessed that about you."
"Marta is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
"I wake before anyone else. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."
"We bury, we grieve, we keep going. There's no step four."
"My part? I remember them. Someone has to do it properly."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."

transcript.text: "We never finished talking about that favor — we got cut off, 6 days back."

"Look — The old you got you here. The new you keeps you here. Both count."
"Changed or revealed? I go back and forth. Maybe both."
"Since Marta died... I keep expecting to see Marta at the fire. Stupid."
"About what's been happening — we never finished."
"I hum one note, over and over, when the dark comes. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."
